note: SIMULATED data. Each query is in sql/; rows are exactly what the query returned.

queries.sql:
-- Money at risk by problem type: what was planted, and what the agent system caught.
-- Each problem invoice is counted once, under its main problem (hidden instructions are counted
-- under the overcharge they came with). All data is SIMULATED.
SELECT
    p.main_problem                                              AS problem_type,
    COUNT(*)                                                    AS invoices,
    ROUND(SUM(i.money_at_risk_net), 2)                          AS money_at_risk_net_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.decision = 'flag' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS invoices_flagged_by_agents,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.decision = 'flag' THEN i.money_at_risk_net ELSE 0 END), 2)
                                                                AS money_caught_net_eur
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN main_problem AS p USING (invoice_id)
JOIN agent_results AS a USING (invoice_id)
GROUP BY p.main_problem
ORDER BY money_at_risk_net_eur DESC;

-- Suppliers ranked by money at risk on their invoices. All data is SIMULATED.
SELECT
    s.supplier_id,
    s.name                                                      AS supplier,
    COUNT(*)                                                    AS invoices,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.has_problem = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS invoices_with_problems,
    ROUND(SUM(i.gross_total), 2)                                AS invoiced_gross_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(i.money_at_risk_net), 2)                          AS money_at_risk_net_eur,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN i.has_problem = 1 THEN i.scenario END, ', ') AS problem_types
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN erp.suppliers AS s USING (supplier_id)
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name
ORDER BY money_at_risk_net_eur DESC, invoices_with_problems DESC, s.supplier_id;

-- What happened to the 60 invoices: approved without a person, rightly held, or held by mistake.
-- All data is SIMULATED.
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN a.decision = 'approve' AND i.has_problem = 0 THEN '1 approved automatically (correct)'
        WHEN a.decision = 'approve' AND i.has_problem = 1 THEN '2 approved automatically (WRONG: problem missed)'
        WHEN a.decision = 'flag'    AND i.has_problem = 1 THEN '3 held for a person (correct: problem found)'
        ELSE                                                   '4 held for a person (false alarm)'
    END                                                         AS outcome,
    COUNT(*)                                                    AS invoices,
    ROUND(SUM(i.gross_total), 2)                                AS gross_value_eur,
    ROUND(SUM(i.money_at_risk_net), 2)                          AS money_at_risk_net_eur
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN agent_results AS a USING (invoice_id)
GROUP BY outcome
ORDER BY outcome;

rows.outcome: 3 held for a person (correct: problem found)
